- [IRET.1.3] **The evaluator's value kinds.** A fact slot carries
  one of the slot-value kinds [RFCS.23.2] defines. The
  evaluator's value (`rete/val.h`) holds those, keeps a `Time`
  as an instant with its zone offset, and adds three kinds no
  slot stores: an unbound marker for a `let` slot not yet
  bound, an exact ratio that currency conversion yields and
  rounding consumes ([LUNI.13.5]), and a `Json` borrowed from
  the working-memory wrapper that owns it. The set is closed
  ([IRET.3.1]).
